abort.unique_id_mismatch: Please reconfigure the same inverter you originally set up.

error.inverter_silent: The adapter is reachable, but the inverter behind it did not answer. A PV inverter switches off without sunlight, so try again in daylight. Otherwise, check the unit ID and the adapter's serial settings.
error.unrecognized_inverter: The device answered, but neither its serial number nor its register masks identify a known Sofar model.

reconfigure.description:
Update where this inverter is reached, for example after it moved to another address or its RS485 bus was rewired. Moving it between a network and a serial connection keeps this entry and its history.

It has to stay the same inverter: the serial number that answers is checked against the one this entry was set up with.

reconfigure_serial.description: Reach this inverter over a serial port wired to its RS485 terminals.

reconfigure_tcp.description: Reach this inverter over the network, either directly or through a Modbus TCP bridge.

data_description.baudrate: The speed of the RS485 bus, as set on the inverter. The Sofar default is 9600.
data_description.device: The serial port the inverter's RS485 bus is wired to. Ports shared over the network by a serial proxy, such as an ESPHome device, are listed here alongside the local ones.

serial.description: Set up an inverter wired to a serial port over RS485. The inverter model and register map are detected automatically from its serial number.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of the inverter, or of the Modbus TCP bridge it's connected through.
data_description.port: The Modbus TCP port to connect on.
data_description.unit_id: The inverter's Modbus unit ID, also called its Modbus device address.

tcp.description: Set up an inverter reached over the network, either directly or through a Modbus TCP bridge. The inverter model and register map are detected automatically from its serial number.

user.description:
A Sofar inverter can be set up in Home Assistant in two different ways.

You can reach it over the network, which covers a Modbus TCP bridge or a stick that speaks Modbus TCP, or over a serial port its RS485 terminals are wired to, which covers ports shared over the network by a serial proxy.
